csv_project_name: Design Svc for MEP & Site Infrastructure Renovation
csv_scope_of_work: Massasoit Community College is seeking to procure engineering House Doctor services for building systems upgrades, repairs, replacements, and deferred maintenance projects (mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection), including decarbonization and infrastructure improvements on campus. The scope of work may include but is not limited to: 1. Investigating the nature and severity of the problem that must be addressed under the task order. 2. Fully documenting existing conditions, including external factors that may not be addressed under the task order. 3. Developing a detailed scope of work and related cost information for the proposed project that references energy costs, sustainability principles, expected remaining useful life of building systems and related life cycle costs in conformance with the requirements of Executive Order 594. 4. Proposing an alternative strategy for the resolution of the problem in conformance with the requirements outlined in #3 above. 5. Developing the preferred solution through schematic design and/or design development. 6. Preparing construction specifications and documents, cost estimates, and providing construction administration services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Programming, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering
